hint.PORT_IN_USE: Another program is using the node's network port. Close it or change the Listen port in Settings → Network, then retry.
hint.DB_LOCKED: The node database is in use by another process, such as another CointMU or geth instance. Close it, then retry.
hint.GETH_NOT_FOUND: The node program is missing from this installation. Reinstall CointMU, then retry.
hint.GETH_NOT_EXECUTABLE: The node program is not allowed to run (missing execute permission). Reinstall CointMU, then retry.
hint.GETH_WRONG_ARCH: The node program is built for a different processor. On an Apple Silicon Mac, install Rosetta 2 by running softwareupdate --install-rosetta in Terminal, then retry.
hint.failed: Your wallet keystore was not touched. Retry, or restart the app; if it keeps failing, report an issue with the logs.
